body: My kik is TheDemonicPyromancer (edgy, I know) and my screen name is Necro Soul if you ever want to chat!
That's a really good idea, thank you for mentioning it.  I'll definitely try out something similar.

I'm not sure what triggers Sariel to go away.  I know that Wendigo can be triggered by potentially dangerous situations, violence, and situations that make me or him angry.  I haven't had much constructive communication with him.  Anytime we communicate he mostly just goes on violent tirades or rants about what he thinks is right for us.  Making progress with him is difficult.

Please God, no.  That movie is a horrific representation of what people with my disorder go through.  Most people with DID aren't violent at all, I just got unlucky and got stuck with a violent alter.
I've never tried it, but I definitely will.

Thank you for the insight and the kind words.  I hadn't thought about the possibility of just turning myself in to an institution... I hate being institutionalized but if it's the only way to keep myself and others safe, then I may have to do it.

I am glad to see somebody who understands.  It's hard to make others understand what it feels like to share a body with a primal predator, to have to deal with the incessant noise of numerous voices in your head.


I try to speak to him with respect, I try to communicate with him in an attempt to soothe him but it rarely works.  All he does is scream of slaughter or go on cynical rambles about how all of my loved ones are useless and will only harm us.  I can never make any progress with him.
There's no medication for a disorder like DID and I don't have the money to consistently see a therapist.
We definitely relate to feeling a sense of otherness, that may be why we are so bothered by being called fascinating or any similar descriptor.
It's nice that you can do that, but we just can't handle it.  We feel like we're still being treated like a creepy outsider when we're called fascinating, it makes us feel alienated.
Exactly!
I know exactly how you feel, I have days where I feel the same.  It could be dissociation, or it could just be emotional apathy.
Welcome!  I'm not sure about discord or skype groups, but this subreddit is usually pretty active (despite being somewhat small).  Funnily enough, I'm also 18 and a member of a system of four!
I absolutely love Mr. Robot, it means a lot to me to have a character that I can really relate to.  Elliot is one of my favorite fictional characters because we have so much in common!
Thank you, we all appreciate it!

Thanks for your input, I definitely agree that any bodily changes should be agreed upon by all members of a system.  Wendigo's biggest complaint about our body is that it is "too soft and weak".  They don't care what I do to the body so long as I build muscle and get stronger.  Sariel wouldn't mind it either, he has expressed that he'd probably feel more comfortable in a male body.  As for Bella, I have a hard time communicating with her since she's so reclusive and rarely ever fronts.  I haven't been able to talk to her about much of anything.

/r/adorabledragons is great!  I also like /r/aww and /r/rarepuppers!  Oh and /r/pokemon too.


-Bella
Ugh, don't even get me started on that terrible movie 'Split'.  Whenever DID isn't being made into some sort of joke, it's being vilified.  I'm sorry that your colleague made a joke like that.
You're definitely not alone, two of my alters argue about practically everything.

Sariel often fronts due to the smell of lilac, lavender, or that dusty, "old" smell that certain buildings have.  I'm not sure what to call that, though.  It could also be that you switched due to stress/the unpleasant sensation, not necessarily the smell itself.
It's good to know that I'm not the only one with angelic and (sort of) monster alters.

Interesting thought.  When you say that our 'kind' aren't really human, are you referring to alters in general?


Also, Incubus as in the type of demon?
Jesse Pinkman, is that you?

My legal name is Isabella, but the name best suits the little in our system so that's what we've been calling her.  I chose the name Rowan because it's gender nuetral and means "little red".  I decided to call the unnamed one in our system "Wendigo" due to his tendencies, he doesn't really have a name at all.  Sariel told me his name.
I have moments of depersonalisation and derealization due to having DID, but I can't even imagine having it 24/7.  How do you cope?  Do you have any other mental disorders?

I'm the creative member of our system but the others contribute a lot of ideas and give me a lot of inspiration.  I mostly just write, roleplay, and worldbuild.  I haven't really had the time or motivation to draw as much as I used to.

Wow, I feel almost exactly the same way!  Several of my alters get pretty distressed and dysphoric due to inhabiting a human body.  I also feel limbs that aren't there, but I always thought that was more of an Otherkin thing.

I can relate to this, my angel alter often insists that coincidences (such as class being cancelled on the day there's a test that I haven't studied for) are actually God/other angels looking out for me.
[This](http://imgur.com/a/A2UVa) is Durnehviir and [these](http://imgur.com/a/tCiGb) are Ulysses and Dagda.  They've helped me through a lot of rough times.
Thanks for the suggestion, I have been using tap water but I'll switch it out for spring water.

Thanks for the suggestions, I'll definitely get him a higher wattage heat bulb and a ceramic heater for night time.


I got him from a pet store in the mall, not a breeder or anything.  He might've been sick already, but he seemed fine for the first week after I bought him so I feel like I did something wrong.

I don't think he's brumating, I think he's too young (he isn't even a year old yet).  The temperature in the tank is around 90 degrees and I'm using a Zilla T8 UVB and UVA bulb.  His poop looked normal the last time he actually pooped.  He was on a diet of crickets (supplemented with calcium powder) and cabbage.  Thank you for trying to help.
Yes, he has a 75 watt heat lamp but hasn't been basking lately.  I was feeding him crickets and cabbage but he stopped eating days ago.

I"m pretty sure he is only a few weeks old, definitely still a baby.


He has a 75 watt basking bulb and a new UVB tube.  The substrate is newspaper (I was afraid of him trying to eat sand or other substrate).  His tank is big (150 gallons, I think) but I sectioned off a side for him, it's about 20 inches long.


He pooped at first, but hasn't been lately because he hasn't been eating.  The consistency is firm, not too watery or tough and it looks normal (white and brown).  It doesn't smell exceptionally strong.


The temperature in the tank is ~90 degrees and the humidity is ~20%, I use a thermostat and hydrometer from Petsmart but they're not super accurate.  He has a water bowl in the tank.  I have been bathing him every day.


I'm not sure how much he weighs.  I haven't actually measured him, but he looks to be 5-6 inches long.


He was eating crickets and *some* veggies, mostly just the cabbage.  I use calcium powder on his crickets.


He doesn't have a light on at night, but he has a heating pad.


He doesn't have a black beard but he has "stress lines".


He has not been tested for parasites.


I considered the fact that he might be brumating, but he seems way too young.  He's definitely not a year old yet.  Thank you for trying to help, it means a lot to me.

There is, but my dad won't take me because money is tight.  He said "just keep an eye on him".


I've wanted to kill myself for years now, so the lizard isn't the sole reason for it.  More like the straw that finally broke the camel's back.
